creator: Boni, Ada
subject: Cooking

description: Il Talismano is and has been for over 20 year the great outstanding Italian cookbook.  It is to Italians what The Joy of Cooking   or the Fanny Famer Cook Book is to Americans. It contains, in simple and clear form and for home quantities and usage, the right recipes for all the notable delicious foods and dishes that make up the beast Italian cuisine. Included are the correct recipes for all the carious styles of Italian cooking: Milanese, Bolognese, venetian, Neapolitan, Sicilian, Roman, Genoese, Sienese, Veronese, Florentine, etc. Now, in this first American edition, weights and measurements, all instructions and terms, have been adapted to American usage and the American equivalent ingredients have been indicated where the Italian product may be difficult to obtain.  It is as easy for American cooks to use as any standard American cookbook and yet expert cooks will find it in a wealth of truly precious new recipes. Mme. Ada Boni is the foremost expert on Italian cookery. Il Talismano, standard for Italians throughout the world, has sold hundreds of thousands of copies. Crown Publishers, Inc. 419 Park Avenue South, New York, N. Y. 10016 1975 reprint edition First ed. published in 1950
